exp.desc:
- All sections, mainly veg and garnish
- Banquets for up to 300, à la carte up to 90 covers
- Food safety records

cl.p1: I ate at The Linden Tree for my mother’s birthday in spring and have tried to recreate your beetroot tartare three times since – never quite as good. That is why I want to learn in your kitchen.
cl.p2: I finished my training in July at a hotel with a busy banqueting operation. I worked every section and liked veg and garnish best. On banquet days we cooked for 300; à la carte we did up to 90 covers. I keep my section clean and ask when I do not know.
cl.p3: Seasonal, local cooking interests me most. I would be happy to do a trial shift whenever suits you.

cl.p1: For the past three years I have run the sauce section in a fine-dining kitchen in Manchester, cooking for up to 120 covers a night. I am moving back to York and would like to join your brigade.
cl.p2: I supervise a commis and an apprentice, order meat and fish for my section and keep recipes and allergen sheets up to date. When we added more vegetarian mains, two of my dishes made the permanent menu.
cl.p3: I can start in April and would welcome a trial shift.
